grouping_resolution.note: Single release retained as one verification unit.

sources.title: Primary source 1: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/releases/tag/v0.5.17
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The SGLang project published v0.5.17 on 2026-08-08 UTC.
The v0.5.17 release notes describe day-0 support for Kimi K3 and MiniMax-H3, an initial Rust frontend, session-reference-aware Unified Radix Cache, and a DeepSeek-V4 FP8 MegaMoE path.

limitations.text: Performance, hardware-compatibility, and resource-reduction figures in the release notes are project-reported and are not independently reproduced in this Evidence pass.

targets.target: Verify chronology, primary-source identity, technical claims, and overlap before selection.
targets.finding: The first-party project release page establishes the W33 release date and the listed feature additions. Quantitative results remain project claims; overlap with vLLM/FlashInfer should be resolved during cross-candidate selection.

unresolved_questions: Which release-note changes are material enough to survive cross-candidate comparison?

editorial.why_now_note: SGLang v0.5.17 was published inside W33 and bundles materially new model-serving, diffusion, agent-session cache, Rust-frontend, and MoE serving work rather than a routine patch.
editorial.rationale: Strong W33 systems candidate; likely useful as part of an inference/serving package, subject to cross-candidate deduplication.
